g.text: Paritok Impact, Development vs Token Efficiency
Cold starts exceed timeout (45.5s observed, 90s default)
No retry or backoff in GpuServerStrategy.compress()
REF hash tag leaks into LLM prompt, corrupts citations
Required custom thread with 8s join() wrapper in llm_client.py
Candidate A: search-loop calls, 1434 to 1442 tokens, -0.56% (below 15% gate)
Candidate B: sourced-summary call, 4159 to 2458 tokens, 40.9% (gate winner)
14-query real-corpus batch: 54% average, 80-95% peak on sparse content
End-to-end gold-set runs: 26.38% to 60.26% across 3 dated runs
